history_summary.value: The North Holland Blue was developed around Purmerend, Netherlands, about 1900 by crossing imported Malines chickens with local stock to meet demand for white chicken meat in Amsterdam. It was a major Dutch commercial meat breed until faster-growing American breeds took over after World War Two.
